question.worked_solution:
Applying the average value formula, we find that the average value of the function is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{\text{avg}} & =\frac{1}{b-a}{\int }_{a}^{b}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{(\frac{\pi }{3}-0)}{\int }_{0}^{\pi /3}\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{3}{\pi }{\int }_{0}^{\pi /3}\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\frac{3}{\pi }(\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x)}{2})|}_{0}^{\pi /3} \\  & =\frac{3}{\pi }[\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{2\pi }{3})-\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡(0)] \\  & =\frac{3}{\pi }(\frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}) \\  & =\frac{3}{\pi }\cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \\  & =\frac{3\sqrt{3}}{4\pi }.\end{aligned}
$$
